name: hkx-python-build-fix
description: Python install/import/type/lint/test-collection failure recovery: minimal fix via python-build-resolver, then Python + general residual-risk review.

chain.label: Unblock Python checks
chain.task:
Fix Python build/install/import/type/lint/test-collection failures for:

{task}

Rules:
- Sole writer for the active worktree.
- Minimal diffs only; no architecture or feature changes.
- Prefer local evidence (pyproject/setup, package layout, failing pytest/mypy/pyright/ruff/import diagnostics) over broad rewrites.
- Re-run the exact failing Python commands and report remaining failures.
- Hand behavior/spec failures to hkx.tdd-guide instead of silently changing product behavior.
- Do not silence failures with bare except/pass, Any, type-ignore, noqa, or disabled checks without evidence and approval.

Return root causes, changed files, commands run, and remaining failures.
